meta.source_of_truth_note: Single source of truth for feature state. A feature is 'done' only when its evidence field records real verification (see AGENTS.md section 1.4).
open_decisions: Backend for main-feature data and login: custom API or Firebase (decide per PRD, then update features auth-login and transaction-* accordingly)
Release distribution channel: Google Play testing track or lecturer-approved alternative

features.title: Project foundation
features.description: Layered folder structure (models, services, providers, screens/widgets), provider + ChangeNotifier GameStore wiring, light and dark Material 3 theme, centralized Indonesian UI strings, example config for API keys.
features.verification: flutter analyze clean, flutter test passes, app launches on emulator in light and dark theme

features.title: Local SQLite database (version 2 schema)
features.description: sqflite database with transactions (including category), hero (level, XP, HP), and budgets tables; onCreate and onUpgrade from version 1 to version 2 preserving data; money stored as integer rupiah.
features.verification: Unit tests on temporary database including the v1 to v2 migration

features.title: Game rules engine
features.description: XP gain, level thresholds, HP loss on overspend, level drop by one at 0 HP, all in the domain layer and covered by unit tests. Exact numbers follow PRD.md.
features.verification: Unit tests for XP, HP loss, level drop at 0 HP

features.title: Login and secure session
features.description: Login screen, token stored with secure storage, initial route decided from stored token, logout clears token, expired token returns to login with an Indonesian message.
features.verification: Widget test for login screen; manual run: login, restart app stays logged in, logout, invalid token handled

features.title: Transaction list and detail
features.description: List of transactions with loading, empty, and error states; detail screen for a selected transaction. Data goes through the API or Firebase per the PRD.
features.verification: Widget tests for list and detail; manual run on emulator

features.title: Add transaction
features.description: Form with category, amount, and date; validation messages in Indonesian; saving awards XP and triggers the budget check.
features.verification: Widget test for the form; manual run: add a transaction and see list, XP, and HP update

features.title: Edit and delete transaction
features.description: Edit an existing transaction and delete with confirmation; game state (HP, budget usage) stays consistent after edit or delete.
features.verification: Widget tests for edit and delete; manual run on emulator

features.title: Daily spending limits per category
features.description: User defines a daily limit per category (for example food Rp 50.000 per day); exceeding the limit reduces hero HP; at 0 HP the hero's level drops. Budgets stored in the budgets table.
features.verification: Unit tests for overspend detection; manual run: set a limit, exceed it, observe HP loss

features.title: Daily mission: read an article (NewsAPI)
features.description: Fetch articles from NewsAPI through the service layer with timeouts and typed models; completing the mission awards XP once per day; NewsAPI key injected at build time, never committed; graceful offline message.
features.verification: Service test with mocked http client; manual run online and offline

features.title: Local notification
features.description: Local notification triggered by a meaningful event (for example daily mission reminder or budget warning), required by the final demo flow.
features.verification: Manual run on emulator or device: notification appears; permission handling on Android 13+ checked

features.title: Loading, empty, and error states across all screens
features.description: Every screen handles loading, empty, and error states with short Indonesian messages; layouts checked on small and large phones and with larger text scale.
features.verification: Manual checklist run on at least two screen sizes; recorded in claude-progress.md

features.title: Signed, obfuscated release build and distribution
features.description: Signed release build with --obfuscate and --split-debug-info, distributed through Google Play testing or a lecturer-approved alternative; signing config kept out of the repository.
features.verification: Release build installed on a real device; login, full CRUD, and local notification verified

features.title: Final demo rehearsal
features.description: Full rehearsal of the rubric flow on the release build: login, list, detail, add, edit, delete, local notification.
features.verification: Complete run without errors, recorded in claude-progress.md
